content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 notification has been issued for 35 vacancies across 13 designations. Of these, 13 vacancies are for Lower Division Clerk and five are for Field Officer. The remaining vacancies are available in administrative, technical, accounts, development and other positions. Candidates must meet the educational qualification, experience and age requirements prescribed for their chosen post. The official notification provides post-wise vacancies, pay scales, reservations and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 35 Coconut Development Board vacancies have been announced across 13 designations. The largest number of vacancies is for Lower Division Clerk, with 13 posts, followed by Field Officer, with five posts, and Deputy Director (Development), with four posts. The complete post-wise vacancy distribution is provided below. The notification states that the vacancies include anticipated vacancies and may be revised. Additional vacancies arising during the validity of the recruitment panel may also be filled, subject to the availability of suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Vacancy 2026 Category Wise
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board has announced vacancies for Unreserved, Other Backward Classes, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates. Certain vacancies are also reserved for eligible Persons with Benchmark Disabilities and Ex-Servicemen. The category-wise distribution is given below. Note: The OBC vacancy for Deputy Director (Development) is a backlog vacancy. One Stenographer Grade II vacancy is reserved for an eligible PwBD candidate with locomotor disability. Two LDC vacancies are reserved for Ex-Servicemen. These reservations are included within the post totals, not additional vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, age limit, experience and skill requirements for their preferred post. Eligibility conditions vary across Group A, Group B and Group C positions. Yes, freshers can apply for Field Officer, Stenographer Grade II, Data Entry Operator and Lower Division Clerk posts, provided they meet the respective educational qualifications and skill requirements. The notification does not prescribe prior work experience for these posts. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide, not a confirmation of individual eligibility. Candidates should check the detailed post-wise eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.

rows.requirements: Class 12, Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree or relevant professional qualification, depending on the post.
Maximum 27, 30, 35 or 40 years, depending on the post. Applicable age relaxations are as per government rules and the notification.
Relevant experience is required for certain posts. Some Group C posts do not prescribe prior work experience.
Typing, shorthand or computer data entry proficiency is required for specific posts.
Candidates must fulfil the post-specific eligibility and documentary requirements mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Detailed Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification, relevant work experience, age limit and skill requirements specified for the post. The recruitment includes opportunities for 12th-pass candidates, graduates and postgraduates. However, several officer-level positions require relevant professional experience. The educational qualifications differ by post. Candidates applying for clerical and field positions must possess the prescribed academic qualifications and skills, while applicants for development, administrative and accounts positions must meet additional experience requirements. Candidates must read the official notification for complete qualification equivalence, experience conditions and desirable qualifications before submitting their applications. The upper age limit for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 ranges from 27 to 40 years, depending on the post. The crucial date for determining age is the closing date for receipt of online applications from candidates in India, as defined in the official notification. The Coconut Development Board provides relaxation in the upper age limit to eligible reserved-category candidates and other specified groups according to the notification and applicable Government of India rules. For Field Officer, Data Entry Operator and LDC posts, the notification provides for relaxation of the upper age limit up to 40 years for eligible Government servants, subject to applicable conditions. Candidates should check the exact relaxation rules applicable to their post and category.

rows.educational_qualification_and_experience: Master's degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Sciences with five years of relevant experience in Level 10 or equivalent, or seven years in Level 7 or equivalent, as specified in the notification.

Master's degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Science with three years of experience in Level 7 or equivalent, or five years in Level 6 or equivalent, preferably in plantation tree or horticulture crops.
Master's degree with five years of administration and establishment experience in Level 6 in an eligible Government or public-sector organisation. HR-related management qualifications are desirable.
Associate membership of ICAI or ICMAI; or Master's degree in Commerce with CA/CMA Intermediate qualification and five years of prescribed accounting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or Horticulture with two years of relevant development experience in a recognised institute.
B.Tech in Food Processing or Food Technology or equivalent, or Master's degree in Food and Nutrition or equivalent, with two years of experience in food processing.
Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science or Commerce with three years of experience in an eligible Government or public-sector organisation.
Master's degree in Commerce or CA/CMA Intermediate qualification, along with five years of prescribed audit experience.

Master's degree in Hindi with English studied at degree level, postgraduate diploma in Hindi-English translation, and two years of relevant translation experience. Additional conditions are specified in the notification.
Graduation with shorthand speed of 120 words per minute and typewriting speed of 45 words per minute.
12th pass with Science and a diploma or certificate course in Agriculture or Horticulture, or equivalent qualification.
Bachelor's degree with a computer speed test requirement of 15,000 key depressions per hour. Diploma in Computer Application is desirable.
12th pass with typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer. Graduation is desirable.

rows.age_relaxation: Up to 5 Years for Reserved Vacancies
Up to 3 Years for Reserved Vacancies
As per Government of India Rules
Special Provisions as Specified in the Notification

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 is Rs.300 for candidates who are not eligible for fee exemption. The payment must be made through SBI Collect. Applications from eligible SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempted from the application fee. Payment Mode: SBI Collect only. The Board will not accept application fee payments through any other method.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board salary varies according to the post and pay level. Selected candidates will be placed in pay levels ranging from Level 2 to Level 11, with prescribed basic pay scales starting at Rs.19,900 for Lower Division Clerk and Rs.67,700 for Deputy Director (Development). The complete post-wise pay scales are listed below. These figures represent the prescribed basic pay scales, not the total monthly take-home salary. Applicable allowances and deductions will depend on the relevant service rules.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 notification refers to a written test or interview and includes specific typing, shorthand and computer speed requirements for certain posts. However, the notification does not provide a complete stage-wise selection procedure or a common written examination pattern for all 13 designations. Candidates applying for Lower Division Clerk, Stenographer Grade II and Data Entry Operator should pay particular attention to the practical skill requirements mentioned in their eligibility criteria. The Board may issue further instructions regarding the recruitment process, examination schedule and assessment requirements on its official website.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026: Official Apply Online Page Applications must be submitted online through the Coconut Development Board website. Candidates can follow the steps below. Visit the official website at coconutboard.gov.in. Open the Vacancy section and locate the recruitment notification dated 6 November 2026. Read the eligibility conditions and application instructions. Open the relevant online application link. Complete the registration or application details as required by the portal. Enter the required personal, educational and experience details. Provide the documents and supporting information requested in the application. Pay Rs.300 through SBI Collect if the application fee is applicable. Review the information carefully before final submission. Submit the application within the notified deadline and retain a copy for future reference. Important: These are general application steps based on the notification. Candidates must follow the exact instructions displayed on the official application portal. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Coconut Development Board Applicants
content_sections.text: Candidates should carefully review the official recruitment conditions before applying. The notification provides important instructions regarding age calculation, employer permission, application accuracy and transfer liability. Applicants must satisfy all prescribed qualifications and experience requirements for their chosen post. The closing date for online applications will be used to calculate the upper age limit according to the notification. The application fee must be paid through SBI Collect by candidates who are not exempted. Incomplete or late applications will be rejected. Candidates employed in specified Government and public-sector organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of the written test or interview. Selected employees may be transferred anywhere in India according to the Board's requirements. Incorrect information or failure to meet eligibility conditions may result in rejection of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 35 Group A, B and C vacancies have been announced across 13 designations, including Lower Division Clerk, Field Officer, Deputy Director and other posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply within 30 days from the advertisement's appearance in Employment News dated 21–27 November 2026. The exact closing date and time should be confirmed on the official application portal.

faq.question: Q3. How many LDC vacancies are available in Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 Lower Division Clerk vacancies, including eight UR, three OBC and two SC positions. Two of the 13 vacancies are reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Coconut Development Board LDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary or Class 12 from a recognised board or institute and possess computer typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi. Graduation is a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies from 27 to 40 years depending on the post. Age relaxation is available for eligible candidates according to the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Coconut Development Board LDC?
faq.answer: The Lower Division Clerk post carries Pay Level 2, with a basic pay scale of Rs.19,900 to Rs.63,200.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.300 through SBI Collect for non-exempt candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q8. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 12 may be eligible for Lower Division Clerk. Field Officer applicants must also have studied Science and possess the prescribed Agriculture or Horticulture diploma or certificate qualification.
